summary.intent: Get the Caliper repo (Rust/OXC replacement for react-docgen-typescript) through its first proper release on the latest Callisto, then reduce CI/gate overengineering and run a cleanup plan (apps/validate, ADRs/docs, dependabot, Homebrew flow), with each piece tracked in Entire trails.
summary.outcome: First release was prepared and merged (Callisto 0.11.0, 0.2.0 changeset, URL fixes, CI fixes) and later bumped to Callisto 0.16.0 (#255). The Equivalence/Parity/Scorecard/Allow-list gates were replaced by a weekly measurement job and local `just bench` (#256), and the dead Homebrew notifier was removed (#258). Trails #87, #88 and #30 were set up, #260 (oracle-only rename) was opened, and the docs/ADR/dependabot fork was still running.

repo: Local `main` can carry unpushed commits: it held 8 never-pushed commits (tsc-client, ADR 0006, AGENTS.md, Entire hooks) that had to be cherry-picked onto the release branch.
Callisto releases any package whose current version has no tag; with nothing ever released, the leftover release PR #22 would have skipped 0.1.0. A minor changeset was used to force 0.2.0.
Callisto's changeset parser does not strip single quotes, but oxfmt rewrites double quotes to single quotes in scoped package names, so `@oxc-react-docgen/vite-plugin: minor` must stay unquoted.
Callisto-generated CHANGELOG.md files fail `oxfmt --check`; `**/CHANGELOG.md` was added to `ignorePatterns` in `.oxfmtrc.json` (#37).
npm provenance requires package.json `repository.url` to match the GitHub repo, so the 13 package.json URLs and README were changed from oxc-react-docgen to caliper.
Merging to main regenerates the release PR via the version-pr job; the job also skips build/execute unless the push is a release-PR merge.

Homebrew is now pull-based: the tap's daily `brew bump` uses livecheck on tags matching `^npm/caliper-docgen@v?(\d+(?:\.\d+)+)$` and builds `crates/cli` with `cargo install`. The repo needs no tap workflow or secrets, so release.yml notifier steps were removed.

`apps/validate` mixed the TS 7.1 oracle (kept, used by `weekly.py --oracle`) with the July fixtures harness (deleted); `tsx` for CLI config tests resolves from this package, and Rust tests create tempdirs under it.
The `just bench` name was taken by the criterion recipe, which became `just bench-criterion`.
`apps/oracle` (renamed from apps/validate) now exposes package `caliper-docgen-oracle`; the `main` ruleset has no required status checks.
Entire auto-creates a trail per PR and rejects a branch that already belongs to another trail, so branches must be linked with `entire trail link` before `gh pr create`.

code.finding: The `--out` missing-parent test failed in CI because miette word-wraps the long temp path mid-name; the substring assertion on `no-such-dir` had to strip the wrapping.
The tag finder and `notify-homebrew-tap` steps were dead after the Homebrew flow moved to pull-based; they were removed in #258.
The header comment pins the Callisto version and must be updated alongside the SHA pins in ci.yml and release.yml.

workflow: Verify claims against the actual tool version: the local callisto checkout was 0.10.0, so 0.11.0 behavior was verified through the GitHub API tag and the downloaded binary.
A green workflow run can still have skipped the publish path; verify on the registries and tags instead of trusting the check.
Forks cannot create or enter additional worktrees; parallel forks need `isolation: "worktree"` or they clobber each other's checked-out branch.
Running `callisto version` in the wrong worktree edits release files; check cwd before running mutating commands.
The repo shell has a git hook and alias interference; `/usr/bin/git` was needed for reliable git commands.
Check the downstream repo's current direction (the Homebrew tap) before declaring integration work done.

friction: The user's recalled callisto 'blocker' could not be confirmed from the repo or history.
Initial analysis relied on a stale local checkout 8 commits behind origin, causing wrong claims about 0.8.0 pins.
CI on main was red from an `install-action` error that disappeared on rerun, and later from the oxfmt dependabot bump flagging archive docs.
Several git commands silently failed or no-oped (stash empty, repeated `git add`/commit calls), requiring retries with `/usr/bin/git`.
Release PR #22 failed Lint on generated changelogs, and a release-candidate run once went green without publishing, requiring investigation.
The Equivalence allow-list generated merge conflicts, stray files on main, and mostly no real catches before being removed.
The first oracle-only fork did no work because it could not obtain a worktree, costing a relaunch.
I built #236 (Homebrew auto-update) against a flow that had already changed.
`just lint` on main was already failing on AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and .entire/agent-guide.md formatting, so #260's Lint will likely show red.
open_items: Merge #260 and the pending docs/ADR PR plus the dependabot `oxc_*` group PR (trail #88); close #247 and #248.
Retire ADRs 0013, 0021, 0023 and 0024 with README tombstones; review 0002, 0003, 0008–0012, 0014 and 0019 against the architecture test.
Fix main's red Lint on AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and .entire/agent-guide.md.
Run the weekly workflow by hand once after #256 to confirm the installs, cache, artifact download and issue step.
Merge #258 and #239 (first release on Callisto 0.16.0, trail #30) and watch `release plan`/`release execute`, which have never run in 0.16.
Remove TAP_APP_CLIENT_ID and TAP_APP_PRIVATE_KEY from repo Actions settings if set; delete stale caliper-homebrew-tap and callisto-homebrew-tap worktrees in ~/Projects.
Uncommitted `.claude/settings.json` and `.gemini/settings.json` regeneration (dropped deny rule, emptied enabledPlugins, emptied gemini hooks) was left unresolved.
Protect `main`: confirm no bypass actors, require signed commits, decide on merge queue; delete scratch/stale remote and local branches and stale trails.
Accuracy gaps deferred: `readonly`, index signatures, `RefObject`, shadcn/antd recall; OXC 0.156 will need another upgrade round; the lost `run-semantic.ts` TS-beta-vs-RDT check has no replacement.
